snippet.title: Will O Wing - Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Explore, harness magic, and guide the wayward through harsh and unchecked lands. Atmospheric locations full of unique puzzles that you can challenge in any order you choose. Piece together the truth of a long-forgotten civilization in this stunning puzzle platformer. 

Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4342200/Will_O_Wing/

Developer: Studio Null Games
X: https://x.com/StudioNullGms
